verification_method: Zenodo REST API record read in-session (https://zenodo.org/api/records/<id>); every source below returned a record; licence, byte size, file count and publication date are copied from that record, not from a paper

provenance_classes.repo_metadata: read from the repository API record
provenance_classes.measured_file: read from the downloaded file bytes
provenance_classes.derived: arithmetic on repo_metadata / measured_file, formula given in results.json

sources.title: Dataset for: Self-Organization Through Local Cell-Cell Communication Drives Intestinal Epithelial Zonation
sources.format: ZIP archives of per-cell CSV (cell_attributes.csv, cell_by_gene.csv, serial_genes_corrected.csv, non_reg_cell_ind.csv), TIFF background images, markdown
sources.subjects: mouse intestinal epithelial monolayers, cultured; cell-transplantation (sprinkling) experiment, 7 regions of interest: 3 at 12 h, 4 at 72 h; 32051 segmented cells in the cell_attributes.csv files
sources.system_mismatch_detail: 2D seqFISH ROI of a cultured epithelial monolayer, not an intact villus unit; no crypt-villus axis, no lumen
sources.caveat: per-cell 'area', 'center_x', 'center_y' are in file units with no stated physical unit; absolute mm^2/cell cannot be derived, only relative cell sizes and per-field census

sources.title: Raw data of the article "Bovine Whey Fractions Restore Epithelial Barrier Function Under TNF-alpha/IFN-gamma Challenge in a Caco-2/HT29-MTX Co-Culture Model"
sources.format: XLSX (raw and processed data per figure)
sources.subjects: human Caco-2/TC7 + HT29-MTX-E12 co-culture monolayers; 42 samples, 126 values, 6 treatment arms, 24 h; TEER normalised to control
sources.system_mismatch_detail: cultured human co-culture monolayer, not mouse small-intestinal villi; reported as percent of control only
sources.caveat: no absolute ohm.cm^2 in the file, so g_mature cannot be set in mS/cm^2; only the relative barrier response is bounded (cytokine challenge -15.81% vs control)

sources.title: Data repository - Spatial reconstruction of single enterocytes uncovers broad zonation along the intestinal villus axis (Moor et al. 2018, Cell 175(4):1156-1167)
sources.format: TSV expression tables (A: LCM villus quintiles, B: scRNA-seq UMI, C: t-SNE coordinates + zones, D: zonation reconstruction) + raw_data.zip
sources.subjects: mouse small intestine; 3 mice for laser-capture villus quintiles; scRNA-seq from GEO GSM2644349/GSM2644350
sources.system_mismatch_detail: in vivo mouse villus axis, but the axis is a segment index (Crypt, V1..V6), not micrometres
sources.caveat: expression zonation, not geometry: constrains the SHAPE of the age-dependent transport/maturation profile, not a length, area or rate
sources.note: files table_C (82 kB) and table_D (4.2 MB) are individually under the 50 MB cap; not downloaded because the 4.18 MB prov already in samples/ carries the spatial per-cell form

sources.title: Annotated mouse intestinal organoid dataset (YOLO format)
sources.total_size_human: 194 MB (1 ZIP: 840 images + YOLO label files)
sources.format: PNG/JPG brightfield images (EVOS FL, 4x) + YOLO TXT bounding boxes, 4 classes (organoid0/1/3, spheroid), 23066 annotations
sources.subjects: mouse intestinal organoids, several culture stages and densities; 756 train / 84 validation images
sources.system_mismatch_detail: 2D transmitted-light organoids; classes encode crypt budding (1-2 crypts early, >=3 crypt units late), not villi
sources.caveat: bounding boxes are in pixels with no physical scale; gives a crypt-count-per-organoid distribution over a culture time course, not mm^2

sources.title: Ilastik_organoid_segmentation (Ostrop et al. 2020, semi-automated intestinal organoid screening)
sources.total_size_human: 405 MB (2 ZIP: Ilastik projects + training data)
sources.format: Ilastik project archives (pixel-classification and object-classification projects, H5-based) over brightfield organoid images
sources.subjects: mouse intestinal organoids; 1 DMSO-control well, 4 biological replicates, 5 timepoints (20 training images)
sources.system_mismatch_detail: organoid growth screen, no villus axis
sources.caveat: supports a crypt growth time course at organoid scale; no physical calibration in the archive listing

sources.title: Mouse Organoids imaged with Dual Oblique Plane Microscopy
sources.format: 3D microscopy image stacks of mouse organoids (DOM acquisition)
sources.caveat: the most promising route to a micrometre-calibrated 3D crypt geometry, but the record is 6.68 GB, i.e. far above the 50 MB prov cap; not fetched in this run

sources.title: Dataset of intestinal histological images showing villus morphology and crypt depth in guinea pigs under control and effective microorganism treatments
sources.format: histological images (10 um sections, H&E) of duodenum with morphometric annotation targets: villus length, villus width, crypt depth
sources.subjects: guinea pig (Cavia porcellus), control vs effective-microorganism diet, formalin-fixed paraffin sections
sources.system_mismatch_detail: different species (guinea pig vs mouse) and 2D sections, so values are not transferable as model parameters without an explicit scaling argument
sources.caveat: morphology only; no turnover, no transport, no barrier quantity

rejected.title: A multi-strain probiotic formulation preserves intestinal epithelial and vascular barriers during challenge
rejected.reason: PREREG criterion 2: the record carries license = null, so reuse terms are not machine-readable

rejected.title: Phases of Canonical Wnt Signaling During the Development of Mouse Intestinal Epithelium (Kim et al. 2007)
rejected.reason: PREREG criterion 3: the only file is article.pdf, a publication, not measured data. Downloaded anyway as the CT1 placebo (samples/895554_article.pdf, %PDF-1.4, no numeric table) to show the harness rejects documents

rejected.title: Embryonal morphogenesis of intestinal villi (Petrenko 2017)
rejected.reason: PREREG criterion 3: single PDF, no data file

rejected.title: Cell Tracking Challenge 3D+time datasets
rejected.reason: criteria 3-4: the repository was read in-session and its 3D datasets are A549/H157/MDA231 lung and breast carcinoma cells, C. elegans, Drosophila and Tribolium embryos. No intestinal dataset exists there, so it cannot constrain this model

coverage_of_model_parameters.note: counted over the 32 rows of parameter_table in inputs/Q115_results.json
coverage_of_model_parameters.headline_gap: No openly downloadable dataset with a micrometre-calibrated crypt-to-tip path, a measured migration velocity in mm/h, a pulse-chase cell-age distribution in absolute cells, or an absolute conductance in mS/cm2 was found in this session. The model's own reference (1885 cells, 26 cells/h, 65 h) therefore remains literature-sourced and unverified against open data.

what_this_does_not_establish: no parameter of the model was refitted; the preregistered FAIL on the mechanistic criterion (>=10% change) and UNKNOWN on empirical superiority stand unchanged

no measured dataset here can decide whether age-resolved geometry beats a constant area, because the required paired (uptake + barrier) measurement under a geometry perturbation is absent from all listed sources
the relative TEER prov constrains only a ratio response, not the absolute g_mature
